name: MysteryThemes Toolkit
author: Mystery Themes

sections.description:
MysteryThemes Toolkit is a companion plugin for MysteryThemes WordPress themes that extends the block editor with reusable Gutenberg blocks and common theme features. It provides blocks such as Post Meta, Content Info, and Post Navigation to help you create and customize content layouts directly in the WordPress block editor. The plugin is designed to work seamlessly with supported MysteryThemes themes while keeping common block functionality separate, reusable, and theme-independent.

Version 1.1.0 includes 11 Gutenberg blocks across two categories:

Core Toolkit Blocks:

  • MT: Post Meta: Configurable post metadata display supporting author, date, modified date, categories, comments, item ordering, separator styles, and icons.
  • MT: Content Info: Clean post statistics block presenting estimated reading time, total word count, publication date, updated date, and author.
  • MT: Post Navigation: Responsive previous/next post links featuring titles, thumbnails, dates, categories, grid/stack layouts, and custom typography controls.

News Portal Theme Free Blocks:

  • NP: Ads Banner: Displays advertisement banner images with link and rel/target options.
  • NP: Block Posts: Category post grids in 4 customizable layout styles (Default, Two Big Posts, Grid Box, Alternate Grid).
  • NP: Carousel: Responsive post carousel slider with category filters and navigation controls.
  • NP: Featured Posts: Grid display of featured posts by category.
  • NP: Featured Slider: Full slider layout with adjacent featured post cards.
  • NP: Recent Posts: Clean sidebar and widget-ready recent posts list with thumbnails.
  • NP: Social Media: Social profile icon links configured via the theme Customizer.
  • NP: Default Tabbed: Interactive tabbed section displaying latest posts and recent comments.

Key Features:
* Modular Gutenberg architecture with theme integration layer.
* Theme-independent design inheriting active theme typography with built-in fallbacks.
* Native Gutenberg InspectorControls and ServerSideRender live previews.
* Dynamic asset loading ensuring scripts and styles load only when required.
* Clean extension points and hooks for future themes and Pro addons.
* Future Elementor framework foundation.

Usage

  1. Open any post or page in the Gutenberg Block Editor.
  2. Click the block inserter (+) and browse the MysteryThemes Toolkit or News Portal Blocks categories.
  3. Select your desired block.
  4. Use the sidebar controls to customize options.

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.3 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
sections.installation:
1. Upload the mysterythemes-toolkit folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Open the Block Editor (Gutenberg) and find the MysteryThemes Toolkit and News Portal Blocks categories.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require a MysteryThemes theme?

No. All Toolkit blocks are fully theme-independent and function with any compatible WordPress theme through built-in fallbacks.

Does the plugin conflict with News Portal theme?

No. When MysteryThemes Toolkit is active, it seamlessly takes over block registration and asset management to avoid any duplicate scripts or styles.

Are Pro blocks included?

No. Toolkit contains only 100% free and open-source functionality. Pro blocks remain inside their respective Pro themes and connect using Toolkit’s public APIs.

What is MysteryThemes Toolkit?

MysteryThemes Toolkit is a companion plugin for MysteryThemes WordPress themes that adds reusable Gutenberg blocks, Elementor Widgets and common theme functionality to the WordPress block editor.

What Gutenberg blocks are included?

The Toolkit currently includes MT: Post Meta, MT: Content Info, and MT: Post Navigation common blocks.

Do I need a MysteryThemes theme to use the plugin?

The Toolkit is designed primarily to work with supported MysteryThemes themes. Some common blocks can also provide reusable functionality independently of a specific theme.

How do I use the Gutenberg blocks?

Install and activate MysteryThemes Toolkit, then open the WordPress block editor and search for the available MT blocks in the block inserter.

Can I customize the blocks?

Yes. The supported blocks provide Content and Design controls in the Gutenberg editor, allowing you to customize their appearance and presentation.

Does the Toolkit replace my theme’s existing widgets?

No. The Toolkit is designed to complement supported MysteryThemes themes and their existing functionality. It adds Gutenberg-based block functionality without requiring existing theme features to be removed.

Is MysteryThemes Toolkit required for News Portal Gutenberg blocks?

Yes, supported News Portal Gutenberg blocks use MysteryThemes Toolkit as their common block and integration foundation.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • Added modular Gutenberg framework and Theme Integrations architecture.
  • Added 8 News Portal Free Gutenberg blocks into Toolkit (Ads Banner, Block Posts, Carousel, Featured Posts, Featured Slider, Recent Posts, Social Media, Default Tabbed).
  • Added extensible Elementor framework architecture and hooks.
  • Added theme compatibility and fallback rendering layer for non-News Portal themes.
  • Enhanced editor previews with live slider rendering and clearfix bounds.

1.0.1

  • Removed unnecessary load_plugin_textdomain() usage for WordPress.org translation loading.
  • Updated plugin metadata and WordPress.org compatibility.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • Added MT: Post Meta block.
  • Added MT: Content Info block.
  • Added MT: Post Navigation block.
  • Added horizontal Content / Design tab interface with native color controls and one-click Design Reset.
